spans.text:
If the user goal contains a `--- file: name ---` block: the content is directly available; use it as input to generation nodes
  - If the goal mentions `"has been indexed"` or `"Use semantic search"`: the planner MUST include a `semantic_search` node before the generation n
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes correct handling of file context and provenance. It distinguishes between inline content (directly available) and indexed content (requiring semantic search), ensuring the system accurately represents how it accesses and uses information rather than fabricating knowledge of file contents.
